versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes were made to functionality or user-facing features.
- Documentation and available tool references remain unchanged.

- Added Google Search Console branding image to documentation.
- Improved documentation formatting by introducing a header image.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release integrating Google Search Console management via ClawLink.

- Query search performance, URL indexing status, and sitemap information from chat.
- Manage verified Search Console sites directly through the integration.
- Guided setup: install ClawLink plugin, pair device, and connect Google Search Console — no manual API configuration required.
- Uses ClawLink’s dynamic tool discovery; all operations require confirmation where appropriate.
- Secure handling: never collects raw credentials; directs users to ClawLink-hosted flows.
